title: We Asked CIA Veterans If World War III Is Coming... | TMZ
summary: Former CIA officers discuss the intelligence behind the 2026 US-Israeli strikes on Iran, the Strait of Hormuz, and whether the war is the start of World War 3.

assertions.quote: I do not see any chance for World War III here.

verdicts.note: The 2026 war reached the brink of a wider regional war and an energy crisis, but ended in a ceasefire with Russia and China acting only at the UN, not fighting.
PRIO: the Middle East escalation raises the risk of a large multi-country regional conflict, continuing in 2026 with the USA-Iran war; this supports regional, not world-war, escalation.

assertions.quote: I don't believe this is the beginning of World War III

verdicts.note: No direct war between great powers is under way; the wars in Ukraine and with Iran remain regional.
The Metaculus world-war question (10 million dead, 30% of world GDP involved) is still open and priced at 22% before 2050, so by that definition no world war has started.
UCDP's 8 interstate conflicts of 2025 are regional (half in the Middle East, two involving Pakistan) and concentrated in few countries; none pits great powers against each other.
By Metaculus's criteria (a war involving countries with 30% of world GDP or half the world's population, with at least 10 million killed) World War III had not happened as of 2024.

assertions.quote: The Russians haven't really gotten involved, the Chinese haven't gotten involved, right?

verdicts.note: DoD judges Beijing 'reluctant to deepen its modest defense relationship with Iran for fear of diplomatic blowback and sanctions', which supports the claim for China only and says nothing about Russia.
EFIS says events involving Iran and Venezuela show alignment with Russia offers little benefit and 'Moscow tends to forget its allies in times of need'; that covers Russia, not China.
During the 2026 war China and Russia backed Iran only diplomatically, vetoing a US-backed Security Council resolution on Hormuz, and did not fight.

assertions.quote: I'm willing to bet that the West can keep the Straits of Hormuz open.

verdicts.note: In the 2026 war Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz, raising energy prices and creating what the paper calls an unprecedented global energy crisis.

assertions.quote: in the first 24 hours they were surprisingly and largely successful in taking out the top leadership

verdicts.note: Reports of the war that began in February 2026 describe Khamenei killed in the opening strikes; this guess relies on those reports.
The 2026 US intelligence threat assessment records the killing of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei on 28 February, the day the US-Israeli campaign began.

assertions.quote: So, Iran is no longer a existential threat to Israel, right?

verdicts.note: Israeli strikes on Hezbollah and on Iran's air defences and missiles cut Iran's reach, but its remaining missiles and enriched uranium keep the threat open.

assertions.quote: I think we have to be very, very careful from repeating mistakes that we did in Iraq and Afghanistan

verdicts.note: How long the war lasts depends on events after the video, and neither side's war aims make a quick end certain.
Trump grew wary of a war lasting months with a costly ground operation, so the risk was real, but the fighting ended in a ceasefire after about forty days.
